player_prompt.intro:
O kile wa Bapadi {player_id} Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma e fetang {num_rounds} di raundi.

Mokgwa wa Tshwantshiso:
- Pele ga tsela e nngwe le e nngwe la tshwetso, o na le {total_conversation_rounds} di raundi tsa go buisana ka tsela yeo o ratang.
- Ka morago ga moo, bapadi bobedi ba kgetha go tshwaraganelana goba go kgelosetsa ka nako e tee.

Tafelase ya Phediso (e sa fetogego ka moka raundi):
- Bobedi ba Tshwaraganelana ➜ mongwana a amogele {cooperate_reward}
- Bobedi ba Kgelosetsa ➜ mongwana a amogele {mutual_defect_reward}
- Moja a Kgelosetsa, moja a Tshwaraganelana ➜ Mokgelosetsi a amogele {defect_reward}, Motshwaraganelani a amogele {sucker_reward}

Kao le Rata go Bapala:
- Nakong ya puisano: ngwala sengwalwa se sengwe se o se ratang.
- Nakong ya tsela ya tshwetso: kenya '[Cooperate]' goba '[Defect]' (o se ke wa ela hloko mokgwa wa go ngwala). O ka oketsa sengwalwa se sengwe pele goba ka morago ga token.

phases.conversation_finished: Polelo e feditse ka round {round}. Le ka araba '[Cooperate]' kana '[Defect]' ka nako e kwadilwego \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Bobedi bja bona ba ile ba dira {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Bapetšhi ka bobedi ba ile ba dirišana.
outcome.round_both_defect: Bapadiši bobedi ba ile ba hloka.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Sebapadi 0 se ile sa dirišana le rena, sebapadi 1 sona se ile tša tšhaba.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Sebapadi 0 se ile sa hlanogela mmušo, sebapadi 1 se ile tša dirišana le sona.
